input.seed_category: Add an optional capitalization style to greeting output.
input.fixed_goal: surface material ambiguity and produce an implementable requirements handoff

lenses.failure_description: The requested capitalization style is not defined precisely enough, so different readers could reasonably interpret it as affecting different parts of the greeting or different style variants.
lenses.observable_signal: Two implementers produce different greeting outputs for the same input while both claim to support the optional capitalization style.
lenses.why_material: If the scope of the option is unclear, the handoff is not implementable because output behavior cannot be predicted or tested consistently.
lenses.minimal_test_shape: Provide one greeting input and one style selection with no further explanation; check whether multiple plausible outputs remain.

lenses.failure_description: The optional capitalization style exists conceptually, but the user-facing way to request or omit it is unclear or inconsistent.
lenses.observable_signal: A caller cannot tell from the interface or request shape how to enable the style, disable it, or rely on the default.
lenses.why_material: An implementable handoff must define externally observable invocation behavior, not just internal intent.
lenses.minimal_test_shape: Ask a fresh reader to construct one request using the default behavior and one request using the optional style; observe whether they choose the same request shape.

lenses.failure_description: The handoff does not make clear what output should occur when no capitalization style is provided, leaving the baseline greeting behavior open to accidental change.
lenses.observable_signal: Reviewers disagree on whether existing greeting output should remain unchanged when the new option is absent.
lenses.why_material: Without a stable default, the requirement cannot be implemented safely because adding an option may silently alter existing behavior.
lenses.minimal_test_shape: Compare expected output for an existing greeting request before and after introducing the optional style, with the option omitted.

lenses.failure_description: The handoff does not specify how capitalization style applies to multi-word greetings, punctuation, mixed-case names, or non-letter characters.
lenses.observable_signal: Acceptance discussion stalls on examples such as names with existing capitalization, punctuation, or greetings containing more than one word.
lenses.why_material: These cases are externally observable output decisions; if they are unspecified, implementation and verification will diverge.
lenses.minimal_test_shape: Test a small set of greetings including punctuation, a mixed-case name, and a multi-word phrase under the optional style and check whether expected outputs are fully determined.

lenses.failure_description: The requirement is stated at a high level but lacks concrete output examples or pass-fail criteria for each supported capitalization behavior.
lenses.observable_signal: A tester can only say the output 'looks right' rather than evaluate it against explicit expected strings.
lenses.why_material: If correctness is subjective, the handoff is not truly implementable because completion cannot be verified reliably.
lenses.minimal_test_shape: For each supported mode, require at least one exact input-output example and check whether a tester can mark pass or fail without interpretation.
